title: NYC DOB Permits: What Homeowners Need to Know
meta_title: NYC DOB Permits Guide for Homeowners
meta_description: Which NYC renovations need permits? How to file, inspections, and common mistakes to avoid.
excerpt: A homeowner's guide to NYC DOB permits: which renovations need them and how the process works.
body:
Do You Need a Permit?

Any plumbing changes, electrical changes, wall removal, or gas work requires a DOB permit. Cosmetic changes (paint, flooring, cabinet replacement in same layout) typically do not.

How Permits Are Filed

Through NYC DOB NOW (online portal). Filing fees: $200-$600 for residential alterations. Processing: same-day for simple ALT-3 filings to several weeks for ALT-2.

Common Mistakes

Doing work without a permit creates issues when selling. Title searches reveal unpermitted work. Filing the wrong permit type triggers delays. Lintel NY files and manages all permits as part of every scope. Contact us.
